name: Scope of Authority
description: The Scope of Authority warbond's weapons from the live game (01.007.200) on HellForge's build: R-40 Sightliner, P-44 Mist, AMW-20 Apex and its backpack, LAS-44 Nova, and the live G-11 Caltrops. Records, projectiles and damage are the live game's own; models, sounds and icons are built from your Steam install.
